newsitem.title: USA: DI Industries sells $175 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: DI Industries sells $175 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of debt from DI Industries Inc was priced via lead manager Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette, according to market source.
The deal was increased to $175 million from an original size of $125 million.
DRL is the second largest U.S. onshore contract oil and gas drilling services provider.
